speech.heard: The USA has a 9.2% bank capital ratio, while Tajikistan has 20.9%. That puts America right next to the global median of 9.1%. This evaluates financial strength by comparing core capital to total assets. In Asia, India has 8.5%, while China has 7.8%. Further down, Canada has 4.9 percent, Nigeria 4.5 percent, and Japan 4.1 percent. At the world's bottom, Equatorial Guinea drops below zero, down 6.4 percent. How strong are bank capital buffers in your country?
